summary: VICI Properties L.P. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $1.75 billion senior notes offering: $900 million of 5.400% notes due 2031 and $850 million of 5.750% notes due 2036. Net proceeds will repay or redeem outstanding 2026 senior notes, including $480.5 million and $1.25 billion tranches due in 2026, plus $19.5 million MGP notes. Redemptions at par plus accrued interest are expected on August 17, 2026. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation. Watch for no material event beyond debt management.
